replacement:
described = ", ".join(f'"{info[1]}"' + f" ({info[2]})" + (" (PRIMARY KEY)" if info[4] else "") for info in info_rows)
        lines.append("Note: Use double quotes around column names with spaces or special characters in SQL queries.")
        fk_columns, fk_rows, fk_truncated = env.execute(f'PRAGMA foreign_key_list("{table}")', max_rows=200)
        fk_info = []
        for fk_row in fk_rows:
            fk_info.append(f"{fk_row[2]} -> {fk_row[4]}.{fk_row[5]}")
        if fk_info:
            described += "\nForeign keys (used to join tables):\n  " + "\n  ".join(fk_info)
        lines.append(f"Table \"{table}\": {described}")
